scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai standing confidently, one hand on hip, winking.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhai, hum Moong aur Chana hai!
scenes.say: अरे भाई, हम मूंग और चना हैं!

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai standing confidently, one hand on hip, winking.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Main hoon Moong Bhai, chhota packet, bada dhamaka!
scenes.say: मैं हूँ मूंग भाई, छोटा पैकेट, बड़ा धमाका!

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai standing confidently, one hand on hip, winking.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Protein aur fiber se bharpoor, body ko banaye majboot!
scenes.say: प्रोटीन और फाइबर से भरपूर, बॉडी को बनाए मजबूत!

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu flexing a bicep, grinning widely.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Aur main Chana Bhidu! Bhook bhagau, energy badhau!
scenes.say: और मैं चना भिड़ू! भूख भगाऊँ, एनर्जी बढ़ाऊँ!

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu flexing a bicep, grinning widely.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Hum dono milke pet bharenge, bina fat badhaye!
scenes.say: हम दोनों मिलके पेट भरेंगे, बिना फैट बढ़ाए!

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu flexing a bicep, grinning widely.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Healthy rehna hai toh humein khana seekh le, bhidu!
scenes.say: हेल्दी रहना है तो हमें खाना सीख ले, भिड़ू!

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai looking thoughtful, tapping chin with a tiny finger.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Humko sprouts banao, ekdum taaza aur energizing!
scenes.say: हम को स्प्राउट्स बनाओ, एकदम ताज़ा और एनर्जाइजिंग!

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai looking thoughtful, tapping chin with a tiny finger.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Ya phir ubaal ke khao, simple aur mast snack banega.
scenes.say: या फिर उबाल के खाओ, सिम्पल और मस्त स्नैक बनेगा।

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai looking thoughtful, tapping chin with a tiny finger.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Tension nahi lene ka, digestion bhi ekdum set ho jayega.
scenes.say: टेंशन नहीं लेने का, डाइजेशन भी एकदम सेट हो जाएगा।

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu giving a thumbs-up, winking.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Bole toh, gyms wale bhi humein khaate hain! Kyun?
scenes.say: बोले तो, जिम वाले भी हमें खाते हैं! क्यों?

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu giving a thumbs-up, winking.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Muscles banane mein hum poora support dete hain, boss!
scenes.say: मसल्स बनाने में हम पूरा सपोर्ट देते हैं, बॉस!

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu giving a thumbs-up, winking.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Doctor se pooch le, agar koi bada lafda hai, samjha?
scenes.say: डॉक्टर से पूछ ले, अगर कोई बड़ा लफड़ा है, समझा?

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai doing a little happy dance, arms up.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Zyada tel-masale se humara asli mazaa chhip jata hai.
scenes.say: ज़्यादा तेल-मसाले से हमारा असली मज़ा छिप जाता है।

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai doing a little happy dance, arms up.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Thoda namak, mirchi aur nimbu, bas itna kaafi hai, dost!
scenes.say: थोड़ा नमक, मिर्ची और नींबू, बस इतना काफी है, दोस्त!

scenes.image: A small, round, bright green [[moong dal]] character with big, sparkling eyes, tiny arms and legs, a red "bindaas" headband, and a cheeky smile. Moong Bhai doing a little happy dance, arms up.
scenes.speaker: MOONG_BHAI
scenes.line: Everyday khao, lekin ekdum bhar-bhar ke nahi, moderation!
scenes.say: एवरीडे खाओ, लेकिन एकदम भर-भर के नहीं, मॉडरेशन!

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu leaning forward, hands open, inviting interaction.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Humara saath doge toh sehat ka level up hoga!
scenes.say: हमारा साथ दोगे तो सेहत का लेवल अप होगा!

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu leaning forward, hands open, inviting interaction.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Body ko rakho fit, mind ko karo sharp!
scenes.say: बॉडी को रखो फिट, माइंड को करो शार्प!

scenes.image: A larger, light brown [[CHANA_BHIDU]] character, slightly wrinkled, with expressive eyes, strong arms and legs, a blue "dhamakedaar" headband, and a confident smirk. Chana Bhidu leaning forward, hands open, inviting interaction.
scenes.speaker: CHANA_BHIDU
scenes.line: Toh bolo, aapko hum Moong aur Chana kaise pasand hain?
scenes.say: तो बोलो, आपको हम मूंग और चना कैसे पसंद हैं?
